head: 80ec737

reviews.name: phase12-spec-review
reviews.note: Measured herdr live (spinner frames send no pane.updated, progress titles flood), found the out-of-order ask race and the missing shell name ('zsh ~'); the one reject was moving views out of Style.swift (lint rule).

reviews.name: phase12-ponytail-review
reviews.note: Caught that display_agent is a human label, not an agent kind (dropped); the rest were small line savings, one suggestion (Return check inside the herdrKey branch) would have broken plain Return.

reviews.name: phase12-e2e-review
reviews.note: Only one to notice no test decoded terminal_title_stripped and that the agent-tab check never forced a process ask; ~4.5 min GUI lock; its front-tile jump was not reproducible (recorded).

reviews.name: phase12-spec-review-2
reviews.note: Found that the reused-pane-id reset itself had two holes (stale answer, no re-ask while shown).

reviews.name: phase12-e2e-review-2
reviews.note: Same agent-tab finding as spec-2 (duplicate), plus a nano/pico guard for CI; read only, no GUI.

reviews.name: phase12-spec-review-3
reviews.note: One low race in the failure path (a stale failed ask clearing asked); everything else confirmed.

reviews.name: phase12-verifier
reviews.note: Found decision D5 still said no pane.updated events; every Build and e2e item verified with file:line and CI.

notes: 4 single-test runs (~1 min each: top is setuid so herdr shows no process; a lazy page's cancelled .task left a pane unasked; XCTNSPredicateExpectation polls ~1/s so a 2 s check failed) and one full make e2e (8.5 min, 38/38). The icon generator takes ~2 min per run (3 runs). CI runs kept being cancelled by newer pushes from both agents.
